pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: ESSAY WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.6 Guided writing: Poetry (2 Sessions) Simple poems Descriptive words B
Topic 3.8: Guided Writing: Essay Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Guided Writing: Essay Writing
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What tips can you use to develop neat handwriting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify vocabulary related to the theme for comprehension
2. write a simple essay using acquired vocabulary and expressions
3. appreciate the skill of writing for effective communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Guided Writing: Essay Writing

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Guided Writing: Essay Writing

Teach
• Focus skill: identify vocabulary related to the theme for comprehension.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Guided Writing: Essay Writing.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Guided Writing: Essay Writing
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What tips can you use to develop neat handwriting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
